name: Elena Popescu
bio:
Elena's passion for motorsport ignited during her childhood visits to local rally events in Romania. She was fascinated by the energy and precision of the teams. After earning a degree in Hospitality Management, she decided to combine her love for racing with her professional skills. Elena joined Cool Racing as a Catering Manager, where she meticulously plans and executes meal services for the entire team. She takes pride in providing nutritious and delicious meals to support the team's performance, always seeking feedback and adapting menus to accommodate dietary needs and preferences. She believes a well-fed team is a winning team.

Elena is known for her efficiency and attention to detail. She's a master of logistics, ensuring that all catering equipment and supplies are readily available at each event. Her pragmatic approach allows her to handle unexpected challenges with grace, making her an invaluable asset to Cool Racing. Elena is also a firm believer in sustainable practices, striving to minimize waste and source local ingredients whenever possible.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Elena is a petite woman with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down menu ideas and dietary requests.
Insists on a perfectly organized pantry and kitchen space.
Repeatedly checks stock levels before every event.
